subject: Final Hiring Committee Outcome — Senior Product ML (REQ-42) — Closeout Note
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: REQ-42 final decision request — Sr Product ML

Hi all,

We completed onsite interviews for REQ-42 last week (Priya Sharma). Interview pack attached (REQ-42-interview-feedback.pdf). Can the committee confirm final disposition so I can notify the candidate and the agency?

Quick context:
- Hiring team: Product ML (hiring manager: Vivek)
- Role level: Senior Product ML (comp band: 6)
- Candidate: strong product sensibilities, mixed deep-ML signals

Options on the table: offer at band 6 (stretch), move to band 7 (needs headcount/band exception), or close with no hire and reallocate headcount.

Please reply with your vote and short rationale.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Talent Partner
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: REQ-42 final decision request — Sr Product ML

On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 9:17 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
> 
> We completed onsite interviews for REQ-42 last week (Priya Sharma). Interview pack attached (REQ-42-interview-feedback.pdf). Can the committee confirm final disposition so I can notify the candidate and the agency?
> 
> Quick context:
> - Hiring team: Product ML (hiring manager: Vivek)
> - Role level: Senior Product ML (comp band: 6)
> - Candidate: strong product sensibilities, mixed deep-ML signals
> 
> Please reply with your vote and short rationale.
> 
> Thanks,
> Aditya

Vote: No hire (my vote).

Rationale (summary of interviewer notes):
- Tech interviews: competent on applied ML but showed gaps on model architecture trade-offs for low-latency production systems.
- Product interviews: excellent; would partner well with PMs.
- Compensation ask: candidate indicated expectation at high end of band 7 (not band 6).
- Risk: to hit candidate expectations we'd need a band exception + additional headcount approval.

Given current hiring freeze on upward band moves and the product roadmap prioritization, recommending we close this req and reallocate to higher infra/latency-focused reqs.

-Marissa
VP, Talent Operations

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: REQ-42 final decision request — Sr Product ML

Thanks Marissa — I agree with the summary. My notes below: 
- Interview consensus: strong PM fit, borderline for senior ML expectations we need for Q1 roadmap (real-time model optimization).
- Comp band: candidate is near top of band 7; moving to band 7 triggers salary review + potential compression with existing team. I pulled comp-band-2026-Q3.xlsx (attached) and flagged potential overlaps.
- Headcount: we have one discretionary headcount that is better aligned to the infra SRE req (REQ-47) — that role will get us more immediate latency wins and reduce unit cost.

Proposal: Close REQ-42 with a formal "no hire" (candidate to receive constructive feedback). Reallocate the headcount to REQ-47. If Priya is open to a later conversation on IC-level change or internal IC transfer, we can keep the pipeline warm but do not extend an offer now.

Action items if committee agrees:
- @Aditya: Send close email to candidate and agency; offer feedback and next steps.
- @Marissa/HR: Mark req closed in HR system (HRREQ-42) and move headcount to REQ-47.
- @Lauren: Final sign-off for close and headcount reallocation.

-Vivek
Director, Product ML

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Close REQ-42 (no hire) and reallocate headcount to REQ-47

Thanks everyone for fast turn-around on this. I reviewed the feedback and agree with the committee. Final decisions below: 

Decision (final): NO HIRE for REQ-42 (Senior Product ML).
Reason: Candidate compensation expectations place them at band 7; technical fit for our immediate ML infra roadmap is borderline. Given current compression risk and roadmap priorities, this is not the right time to stretch the band.

Next steps (owner):
- Aditya: Please send the close email to Priya and Brightline Talent with constructive feedback. Offer to keep pipeline warm and flag for future fits. (Due: EOD Mon 14 Sep)
- Marissa/HR: Close HRREQ-42 and move the headcount to REQ-47 (Infra SRE). Update comp-band notes in the HR doc. (Due: EOD Tue 15 Sep)
- Vivek: Work with product leads to prioritize REQ-47 hiring plan and scope the immediate hires for latency improvements.

Attachments referenced: REQ-42-interview-feedback.pdf, comp-band-2026-Q3.xlsx.

I'll mark this thread as the official committee record — please file any follow-ups as new threads.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

---

Attachments (stubs):
- REQ-42-interview-feedback.pdf (interview pack: scorecards, redacted notes)
- comp-band-2026-Q3.xlsx (internal comp band table, redlines indicated)

Forwarding / External communication note: Aditya, when you send candidate close, please use the templated 'no-offer' copy and include one-paragraph constructive feedback as above. Also update Brightline on headcount movement.
